name: App Icon: FLUX Horned Kabuto Crest
purpose: Primary App Icon — FLUX.1 [schnell] Warlord Helmet Crest.
description: Symmetrical solid black samurai warlord kabuto helmet with curved horns and demon mempo faceplate inside a flat red circular disc.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game logo icon. Symmetrical pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai warlord kabuto helmet with curved horns and demon mempo face mask with sharp red eye cutouts. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only. Razor-sharp vector edges, no 3D rendering, no human face, no text, no watermark.
